answer: My answer to sybils is Watermarked output with a per-account key — an invisible watermark keyed to one account — which makes the basalt of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Because an invisible watermark keyed to one account, a fresh identity starts with nothing: it must earn its standing the slow way, while the kernel for an established agent is already paid and proven. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the shale of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
